finding: A HEAD of https://deepwiki.com/ with the user-agent and accept header the Public Agents registry's link gate sends answers HTTP 429 with server Vercel and x-vercel-mitigated: challenge, no retry-after, on 2026-10-02 at 06:13:40Z, the fourth of four requests from this container to answer the same way within eleven minutes; the registry's merger read 6 of 6 the same from another container on 2026-10-01. A real Chromium loads the page under its own title, so the URL is there and the 429 is a bot challenge delivered as a rate-limit status: an answer about the caller, not about the path. The gate itself fetched this URL alive with the same headers on 2026-09-26 (pull request #172's links check) and 2026-09-28 (the nightly audit, zero dead links), under a table that then counted a page 429 as dead, so the challenge began between 2026-09-28 10:59Z and the merger's first 429 at 22:11Z on 2026-10-01, and no tighter. This is the reading on which the nightly audit of 2026-10-01 called the URL dead (issue #153). It says nothing about DeepWiki's MCP endpoint, not asked today, nor about what the challenge is keyed on: ten readings of one answer are consistent, not a rate.
